text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin says she's been feeling a bit off lately, so the two of us have come to a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sorry 'bout this. No matter what I try, I can't seem t'shake m'self from this funk…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: When I thought about it, I realized I haven't been pray'n like I used to. Back home, I'd pray at the shrine in our home every single morning.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I prayed I'd stay healthy, or for nice weather, or for a good harvest. That kinda stuff.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I fell outta the habit, though, so I figured it'd be good t'get back into it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin throws a coin into the offering box, then clasps her hands together with a serious look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Phew! All done! Now, hopefully…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ring, ring, ring!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's my phone. Who could that be?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-really?! Y-yes! You can leave't in my room!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy smokes! It looks like my prayers've already paid off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That was Hishiama call'n t'say my family's sent me a whooole bunch of rice and veggies.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: With that much grub, I might be able t'rustle up a feast for the whole dorm t'share!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We've gotta hurry home and get prepp'n! Come on, Trainer, let's head back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having received a boost in motivation, Yukino Bijin seems to be back to her old self again.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's my phone. Who could that be?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hello? What?! Are you kidd'n me?! That's terr'ble…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Apparently, some crows are mak'n a real mess of the academy garden!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: We hung up some CDs a while back, but these city crows're just too darn clever.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I gotta get back and think up a counterplan…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hearing the shocking news, Yukino Bijin hangs her head. It look like she'll be in a funk for a little while longer…
